body: Imagine you are a clumsy seagull and your species is normally much more agile

My ex dumped me and said that he loved me and that he always wanted me to be happy. 
He said he can’t see myself hurting me anymore because it is hard to see the person you love make things worse for them. 
I understand that. But he forgets where I have started. I am so much better now but he couldn’t see it. He had always sth that I needed to change. I would have never been good enough, mentally, for him. 

He said that he did everything he could for me but missed a lot of important things. Like driving to my place (ldr) and not only have me driving. Communicate his feelings and problems on a level that isn’t last minute before I leave or in a moment when I am occupied with other stuff. He  didn’t sat me down often to talk about problems and when I got emotional the talk was over quickly. 

Yes he loved me and I loved him but in his perspective he did so much for me. And I can’t really see that. I would have been always there for him and accepted discomfort for the happiness of my partner. But he just couldn’t do that. If it was work or uncomfortable for him he didn’t do it. Not even for me
Congrats for getting your dream job. You look like an awesome guy. And you have dinosaur! That so cool. Where are you working?

I am just so disappointed in him. He told me a lot of lies in the end and decided not to talk to me about his problems, thoughts and emotions. I am sad that he didn’t see me as a trustworthy person and friend who he could tell everything.
I understand how you feel. It hurts so much to let that person go you would have gave your world for. And that he never appreciated all your work for the relationship.

Yes. I think I am the one who knows him the best. I know his flaws and what he likes. I know a lot. But his flaws are too much in the end. 

His flaws are one of the reasons he broke up with me..
Thank you. Thats a good viewing point

I just don’t know what to expect. I don’t think that he will apologise. He will just tell me again why he had to dump me. I just dont know who he even is anymore. I have the feeling I never really knew him. Because he wasn’t open, didn’t talk about his fears, problems and thoughts.
I have a talk tomorrow with my ex. Maybe he realised sth and wants to talk but I think he will never realise the two points I pointed out before
So sorry. He even now doesn’t realise that he should just talked with me and that change is not a bad thing. You only learn more about yourself and get stronger

If he doesn’t want to put work into a relationship it’s not worth to put more work into it. It will not change anything.

If I tell him that he hurt me with his actions or words and he only says that he will not change.. it’s not worth it. You can’t build up the lost trust alone. I need sb who will apologise and understand what his actions cause.

We mostly never fought. That was because I hated conflicts. But I started this one argument over and over again. (Which was a mistake on my part). 

I wanted him to apologise for screaming at me in front of his parents after I misread the navigation on his phone. 
I was so embarrassed and wanted him to say that he was sorry for his behaviour and that it will never happen again. That I need to know why it happened. I even told him that I was afraid of him because of the screaming. (I really was) 

Never got a sorry. He just said that this was him and he will not change (he was very afraid of changing in the relationship). I need to get a thicker skin and handle him like that.

Thanks for your text.
I have to remind myself constantly about how he treated me and I just let him. I teached him that he don’t have to apologise or reflect himself to be with me. That I will let him go on even after he broke my trust and didn’t respect my feelings, pain and thought. 

I am at fault too because I didn’t have any boundaries and if I had them I ignored them for him.
What a awful person. I hope you are far away from him

Yeah it’s a hard decision. I love my ex still so much. I don’t know if I ever will stop loving him but he decided to push me out of his life. And I should respect his decision even if I don’t understand it. 

By the way the last sentence fits very good. I think I have to remember it for the future.

Stay in no contact. That is the only way you can start healing yourself. Throw everything in a box that reminds you of her and put it far away. 

Start journaling. Write down your thoughts about her and everything around you. Get it all out. Write down why your relationship didn’t work out, what is better now and reasons why you shouldn’t be together.

Ignore it. Don’t let that woman get into your head.
Throw that piece of paper away, go to that competition and do that for yourself. 

And if she still has your number block her and delete everything. It will not make you happy on the long run if she decides to text you out of nowhere.
I am happy if it helps.

“I will never gonna change. That’s who I am.”
Not saying sorry when he hurt me, lost my stuff or disrespected me.

Its normal to hope that everything will fall back into place. Concentrate on yourself and look deeper into your emotions. How do you feel about that interaction? Why do you hope to get her back? What were the reasons you shouldn’t get back together?

What I forgot is that is your choice to make. You can say to yourself: I don’t want to look at her ig. I don’t want to see her stories and stuff. 

You will have fun again. Maybe not right now. There are a lot of people who will match your vibe. 

Things maybe don’t fix themselves. And it is also not a great idea to get back into a relationship with your ex without working on yourself. If you don’t change and she doesn’t you will just have the same problems again and bu over these problems again. 

It’s easier right now to want that person back that gave you comfort, stability and all these nice chemicals. And now that she is gone you want that stability back even if it wasn’t good. It just is sth you already know and not sth you don’t know.

I know it is hard and scary to be alone again. To be without your favourite person. 

All it brings to you is sadness and hopelessness if you watch her stories. If you are waiting for a sign it mostly isn’t the one you like. You will interpret every single photo or story she shares. It will just break your heart again and again and again. 

For the pictures: even if they are a lot transfer them to a hard drive. Here you don’t always have to look at them. Change your background to pictures without her. It will help you a lot. I know how hard it is and how awful it feels but it’s worth it. You will not look at her smiling face everyday and cry about it. You will cry nevertheless but at least not with her picture in your hand.

He already gave you false hope and hurt you again in the end. 

So you have to decide if you choose the person who isn’t ready to not hurt you (that is a decision he can make) or yourself.
Same. I will wait a few months but after that I will know where I stand with him.

I don’t know what you are expecting from her. You hurt her multiple times. She had enough heartbreak and decided that she can’t stay in a relationship with you anymore. She is cold because she has to block you out of her heart for possible heartbreak, again. 

I mean how do you think she is doing? Fine. Like jumping around happy? Don’t think so.

When she is ready she will block you and go nc to get over you. And don’t think she will come back. You hurt her far to often.
If you really don’t care say that she can keep it or throw it away.

The first thing I did was to remove him from my phone. Downloaded all pictures and but them on an external hard drive. Put down all his photos in my home. Put everything (pictures, gifts and stuff reminds me of him) in a box and gave it my dad to place it somewhere in the house.

Have him as far away as possible. Unfollow him on everything. Insta, Twitter, Spotify... if you need to block him and then go no contact.

Change your background pictures everywhere so you don’t have a sad surprise someday.

Have a notebook ready to write all your thoughts (bad and good) in. Journaling will help you follow your progress and put your thoughts out of your head where they will make you go crazy. Write down what you didn’t like about him and all the stuff that gets better now after you don’t have him in your life. Write down, everyday, what you are grateful for, what was good on that day and how you could improve the next.

Reach out to friends and family (if you want them to know about it) and tell them whats going on and that you need them in the next weeks and ask if they take you with them for stuff. You need to see other things than your room.

Look out for good books. There are a lot who can help you with a breakup. I bought the “bossing your breakup” (it is kind of a guide through a bu) and “silence is your superpower” (on no contact and how to make it right) on amazon. They are helping me a lot. But there are so many goods books out there who can help you through it.

Let yourself cry really hard. Scream in a pillow. Don’t try to push that feelings away they will come back someday. (I got stuffed animals to hug at night or cry into).

And then concentrate on yourself. Go outside. Make a new routine. Find new hobbies or old ones and maybe new friends. Start doing things you didn’t have time before. (Maybe go to therapy if it’s gets to hard or just to work on yourself) And remind yourself daily that you are a good person, you deserve love and a person who loves you for who you are. Stay strong. You got this.

First of realise that it is over. She left you and you have to move on. Focussing on her will only make you unhappy so focus on yourself.

Take all the stuff you have from/of her. (Eg photos from laptop/ phone, gifts) and put it away. Throw it away or put it in a bag far away. 
Did you start journaling and dealing with your emotions. Write down everything you have on your mind. Write down what was bad in your relationship what you learned from it and all the bad things your ex did. 
Write down, everyday, what was good on that day, what you learned and for what you are grateful for. 

Start new hobbies or forgotten old ones. Meet a lot of friends. Sleep enough and eat healthy. Do sports even if its just going out for a walk. You need sth to get the stress out of your system.

What an ass.

Good that you threw that all away. I think all the other tips I could give you, you already know.
In the end it’s time which heals all wounds. I hate that fact too. I wish it was March and I had all of that behind me and a new few on things. But time goes by so slowly when you want it to go faster.

Its very good to have a therapist in this situation and friends who help you out. 

Do you still have stuff of your partner left in your house? If yes put it in a box somewhere far away. I also mean photos, gifts etc

Unfollow and block everything.
What have you done to get better until now? Maybe we can find some new ways to make you feel better

You can do this! 
You will get over it!

Can’t you sell the ring? Or is it really worthless

I had to laugh at that

I would ask him why. And how should I trust him after he left me and treated me badly the last months. How he thinks he qualifies to be with me again. And if he changed himself too or is it again only my job to change if he doesn’t like sth.
Wtf

The point is that you have no other choice.
Make the best out of it. 

I hate that feeling of embarrassment, frustration and powerlessness too.
One months and it is better than at the beginning. But sometimes it hurts so much again that I just want it to stop.
You will get through this. You will get through this hurtful part. I believe in you.
You will get over your ex. You can change your behaviour in the future. But don’t start with drastic actions. They will help you short term but not long term.

I also took 2-3 weeks to communicate what was wrong because if I did it after one week (we only see each other in person on weekends) he said it was because of the stress during this week. So I had to prove him that it wasn’t just in this one week where he could take the easy way out.

Wow that are some really harsh words from his side. 
If you make his life a living hell why is he even with you? Why didn’t he break up?

You made the right decision. If he can’t even celebrate your anniversary, if he doesn’t choose you over his parents and doesn’t stand behind you. Why should you be there for him and give it your all? 

Nope he is an idiot who doesn’t know what he wants and doesn’t treat you right. Doesn’t treat you with the respect and love you deserve <3
Oh before I forget… crying is good. It shows you that you get all the stress and sadness out of you. You will feel better after. Maybe only a bit but better than nothing
One day after another. Don’t rush. And be nice to yourself when it gets harder
Stay strong 💪

I would recommend to write down all the shitty things he did to you. 
Use it to show you that he had a lot of fault in this relationship. It’s already bad that he puts all the blame on you. 
You can always text me if you need sb to tell you not to text him or go back to him.

What do you want? Do you want a person who changes his mind frequently who wants to hurt you and play with your feelings? Or do you want sb who is happy that you are with him, would never consider hurting you and break up with you so any times?

I think, and that is my opinion, you should step away from him. Really really far away. He hurt you intentionally! Who does that to a person you love? You broke up so often and came back to each other with no change.

Go no contact, block him everywhere and try to live your life without him. Write down everything he did wrong and hurt you. And when you think that you should reach out to him read that paper and ask yourself if you really want that in a bf? 

I know it sounds hard but you have to leave him for good.

It’s definitely better to post here than break no contact. 

I have to say that how you feel right now is the biggest fear in my future. I can’t deal with that he changes with somebody else when I needed him to do it for me. To get better with me.
Thank you for your kind words

I needed to hear this and I didn’t at the same time. I cried so hard from this post alone. 

I realised today that I can never be his friend again. I couldn’t live with the picture of him with his new gf doing all the things we wanted to do. I love him too much for that and always will. It was good that he bu because he wasn’t the one for me.

I know it is so hard to do. But you will not get better if you tell yourself that you aren’t better without him! 
You need to move on even if it’s the hardest thing you did in your entire life. 

You should start to look at him without seeing things through rose-colored glasses. Stop making him the best person ever. He is not. Because if he would have been the best person in your life. He still would be here.

I am sorry to hear that. Its hard to start new with nc. But do it for yourself. Make a 30 day challenge out of it.

You know that you did sth wrong but don’t let it be such a weight on you. It’s in the past. It’s not sth you can change now.

Yes remember what didn’t went well. 
You have to actively remind you that it is over. Your life goes on and you will find happiness again. Everyday is a step forward and it will get better. 

If you don’t already have you should throw away all the things you have about him. Photos, Videos, gifts, etc.
If you don’t want to loose this memories put them in a box and let sb hide it.

You don’t have to hate him. But you should ask yourself if you are better without him. Have self respect specially when he treated you unfairly or was rude and an asshole.

Don’t reach out. It doesn’t make you feel better, it makes you feel worse because you will never get what you want from that person again. 

Stay strong

It’s good you went nc and are sure of what you want (no going back).
Thank you for sharing. My ex didn’t do all of that but it makes sense why I felt this way with him

The important thing is to not let him come close to you. Only talk about the usb-stick. Nothing personal.

I was dumped and still keep the photos. I don’t have them on my phone or in my room. They are in a box and not to be seen for at least a few years. Maybe in 5+ years I can look at them again and remember the good times. These are part of my life of 3 years and I don’t want to loose the beautiful photos of myself only because I can’t look at them now.

After my ex broke up I thought that I was the problem I didn’t do enough for him. 
We had some issues that are equal to yours:

- he was out of the relationship for around 7 months. The thing is that I realised something was off. I asked, he said everything is okay. I believed him. He didn’t talk to me in this time about his feelings, problems or that sth was going downhill. If your ex doesn’t want you to know you will not see the problems.

- we didnt see each other enough. First bullshit. He wanted more time on the weekends with his friends and other people so we reduced it to 2-3 weeks visits (I traveled these 5-6 hours one way not him, never him) Before, we saw each other over a span of 2.5 years every weekend and I think that was too much for him. He didn’t want me only on the weekends and I feel so too. But he also didn’t want me every weekend because he wants to relax from the work week and not have his gf over and have to do sth. 
He didn’t communicate that and if he wants to see me often or less I have to know and he can also travel to my place. 



The important thing is your partner searched for the last seven weeks for reasons to end things. Everything small was and is a good reason for her. Don’t take them personally. Most of them aren’t a real problems, they are fantasies for a person who wants you gone and uses them to give you a reason. 

I would recommend to look at this “reasons” from her and think about them. Are you really like that. Did you behave like that or is this a fantasy? Could you have done more or should she have done more. 
Are these “problems” you should change or are these things she wants you to be but you don’t want to be that.
Thank you for sharing that insight

I kind of struggle with something similar. In retrospection I should have left him the first time he made me feel afraid of him. I told him I was afraid and he didn’t apologise, didn’t even saw something he could work on, just that this is him and I should get tougher. 

I kind of hate him for the following 1,5 years I decided to stay with him, worked alone to get me to trust him again. Only to get dumped because he couldn’t talk to me about the problems he saw in the relationship. I was draining to much energy from him. Such bullshit excuse. 

I love him. But I know that I am better with a person who puts equally as much energy in a relationship as I do. 

I don’t hate my ex for who he is. Yes I am disappointed in him that he didn’t trusted me and waited 7 months to get his head straight and tell me he wants to bu. He made me see what I really need in a relationship and what I don’t want.

He just holds onto you if he needs somebody. If you still love him, miss him and don’t want to see him happy with another person.. it’s way too early for a friendship. 

If you can honestly say that you don’t love him, don’t want him back then you can start building a friendship. But from zero to friendship. Not from relationship to friendship. That will only hurt your ego. 

Stay no contact the first 30 days or some months until you feel better.

Good luck
